result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks and wide, well-maintained sidewalks. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the wide corner radii and lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions are notable.

hazards.name: Wide corner radius
hazards.description: The corner design allows for higher-speed vehicle turns, which increases the risk of collisions with pedestrians in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The image shows an urban intersection with modern multi-story buildings and a large transit bus partially obstructing the view of the crossing area. While sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the bus creates a significant visual barrier for pedestrians and drivers at this moment.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large transit bus is positioned in the intersection, completely blocking sightlines between pedestrians on the corner and any oncoming traffic from the adjacent lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, blocking the intersection view

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions or 'no parking' zones near the intersection to ensure clear sightlines even when large vehicles are present.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle green light.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style pavement markings to increase the visibility of the pedestrian crossing area.

result.summary: The street features a wide, well-maintained sidewalk but lacks any visible pedestrian crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or signals. A large bus on the left creates a significant visual obstruction, increasing the risk for pedestrians attempting to cross the multi-lane roadway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Large Vehicle
hazards.description: A large bus on the left side of the street blocks sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and vehicles in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the frame, occupying a significant portion of the street view.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no visible marked crosswalks, which may lead to unpredictable mid-block crossing behavior in a commercial area.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire roadway area in the foreground.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility patterns to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and improve driver awareness.

interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers, especially around large vehicles.

result.summary: The image depicts a dense urban intersection with marked zebra crosswalks and paved sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure like traffic signals and curb ramps are present, the environment is cluttered with sidewalk debris and lacks advanced safety features like curb extensions or street trees.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Large piles of trash bags are placed on the sidewalk, narrowing the effective walking path for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground on the sidewalk near the corner.

hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.

interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

interventions.description: Install street trees to provide shade, improve the pedestrian experience, and naturally calm traffic speeds.
